hero.descriptionLiteral: Floripa Dignidade is a civil society organization dedicated to the steadfast defense of human rights, independent public budget auditing, and territorial support for vulnerable communities across Florianópolis.

framework.descriptionLiteral: Structured under Brazilian Federal Law 13.019/2014 (MROSC), the organization maintains full political and partisan independence to audit municipal contracts, collaboration agreements, and public shelter facilities.
framework.territorialJurisdictionLiteral: Florianópolis Metropolitan Area • Santa Catarina, Brazil

pillarsSection.headlineLiteral: Bread, Shelter and Law: The Three Seeds of Citizenship
pillarsSection.descriptionLiteral: Our civic intervention connects immediate material relief, safe shelter, and legal defense before public authorities and judicial courts.

pillarsCollection.descriptionLiteral: Solidarity kitchen networking, municipal food program auditing, and emergency supplies dispatch.
Public shelter monitoring, protection of unsheltered populations against institutional violence, and housing rights defense.
Strategic public-interest litigation, algorithmic municipal expenditure auditing, and safe reporting channels.

metadata.pageDescriptionLiteral: Discover Floripa Dignidade's mission, legal constitution (MROSC), and three impact pillars.
